- Clicking on the top-left cell moves the square up-left
- Clicking on the top-right cell moves the square up
- Clicking on the bottom-left cell moves the square left

Given this, maybe the goal IS to move all squares to the top row, aligned with the colored squares? Let me check:
- Colored squares at columns 1, 5, 9, 13
- Magenta squares at columns 14-15, 32-33, 41-42, 44-45

If the goal is to move squares to columns 1, 5, 9, 13, then:
- Square at (33, 14) can move to column 13 (1 left) and row 1 (32 up)
- Square at (50, 41) can move to column 13 (28 left) and row 1 (49 up)
- Square at (56, 15) can move to column 5 (10 left) and row 1 (55 up)
